en.description:
Mini-Golf Masters is the easiest way to keep score for a round of mini-golf. Add your players, tap in each stroke, and let the app do the rest - the leaderboard re-sorts after every hole and your round autosaves so a score is never lost.

LIVE LEADERBOARD
Standings update as you play. Lowest score takes the cup.

AUTOSAVES EVERY STROKE
Close the app, lock your phone, or lose signal - your round is right where you left it.

BUILT FOR THE COURSE
• Works fully offline, no signal needed
• 1-6 players, 9 or 18 holes, adjustable par
• A bright on-course theme for sunlight and a dark broadcast theme
• Share results as a link or a tidy result card
• Round history to revisit past games

NO STRINGS
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Just you, your friends, and the scorecard.

Whether it's a family outing or a friendly grudge match, Mini-Golf Masters keeps score so you can focus on the putt.
en.releaseNotes:
LIVE BROADCAST

Share a link or QR code from any round and let people follow along as you play — on a phone at the next hole, a tablet in the clubhouse, or a TV. Nothing to install and no account to create. Scores appear as you tap them, and the same link keeps the final result once the round is over.

The broadcast is made to be watched: a full-screen leaderboard, the hole-by-hole scorecard, a race to the posted hole, and a ticker of the latest scores, with fullscreen and pause when you want them.

Standings only count holes the whole group has finished, so nobody jumps the queue — scores still coming in are shown separately.

Your scoring never waits on the network. Publishing happens quietly in the background and catches up on its own if the signal drops.

REAL BALL COLOURS

Players now pick from eleven colours sampled from an actual tray of mini-golf balls — red through mint and forest green to magenta — or set a colour of their own. Every name, initial and score cell works out its own contrast from the ball, so it stays readable in bright sun and in the dark theme. Your Apple Watch shows the same colours.

Rounds you have already saved or shared will show the new colours.

ALSO

Fixes and polish across scoring, the scorecard and sharing.
en.subtitle: Keep score, crown a champion
